body_en: Many students feel busy after school. They have homework, clubs, and family time. A good plan helps: finish hard tasks first, then rest. Ask teachers when you do not understand. Reading every day builds vocabulary. Small steps, kept for weeks, often work better than one long night. When exams come, review what you got wrong — those gaps are your next lessons.
body_zh: 放学后很多同学觉得忙：作业、社团、家庭时间挤在一起。好计划先啃难的，再休息；不懂就问老师。每天读一点能长词量。坚持几周的小步子，往往比熬一个通宵更管用。考试来了，先复盘错题——那些缺口就是下一节要攻的。
